publication.note: Recorded before the reviewed OIDC dispatch: the npm block, registry tarball sha256 and Release asset identity are filled in after the protected npm-publish environment approves the workflow. CI repacks the same committed sources, so the CI tarball differs in tar metadata only; extracted file contents are identical.

en.title: Skills Manager
en.description: Discover, install, check and update DSH skills, with safe removal and restorable backups.

zh.title: 技能管理
zh.description: 检索、安装、检查和更新 DSH 技能，支持安全删除与备份恢复。

userActions: Approve the npm-publish environment for the dispatched Release workflow; the publish job then runs the verified tarball through OIDC and creates the v0.5.0 tag/Release.
Update 技能管理 from Plugins once 0.5.0 is on npm (the Versions section appears for npm installs) or install it from Discover, then refresh the page once.
Open 设置 → 技能管理: the three number cards are clickable filters and the page shares the rest of the Settings surface; Electron Desktop visual acceptance is still yours.
